title: Gyeonggi Bao
description: A Korean-inspired dish featuring a pillowy, umami-filled bao served with an orange-zest infused sauce and crispy kimchi slaw. Perfect for a low-key, date-night dinner.

ingredients.name: Mung Bean Paste
ingredients.notes: You can make your own or use store-bought

instructions: Prepare bao dough according to package instructions or recipe.
Divide dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on desired size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of mung bean paste onto one half of each circle.
Add a sprinkle of Korean chili flakes if using.
Fold dough over filling and press edges to seal.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, mix soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar in a small bowl.
Add freshly grated orange zest and stir to combine.
Serve bao with dipping sauce and kimchi slaw on the side.
Optional: garnish with toasted sesame seeds or chopped scallions.
